change_scope: Contributor auditor, shared Mach-O artifact admission, hosted Mac CI ordering and source documentation only. Runtime/routing/TLS behavior, dependency graph, lockfile, version, package caps and shipping default are unchanged.
contract: Separate hosted-Mac profile, exact original public ci.yml/rust job/runner/host and clean checkout; GNU keeps its standalone toolchain, pinned builder and required builder-report admission.

Shared begin/finish feature audit, cold release tree, fresh:false compiler-artifact requirement and inode-aware create-only output/cleanup. Mac begin omits builder report; SDK witness is bound through inputs_sha256 and builder_report_sha256 is null.

Observe Rustup invocation shims and actual installed rustc/Cargo/sysroot/driver, selected Apple SDK/settings and compiler/linker/archiver identities before/after. Preserve clang++ invocation name separately from canonical executable bytes.

Selected public environment is bounded and rejects unknown effective build overrides. Cargo home/ancestor configs, explicit CPU/SDK/deployment flags and tools are witnessed. Missing toolchains are refused before rustup resolution.

Separate 512 MiB supplier-tool bound uses fixed 64 KiB streaming reads, preserving all product/report/archive bounds. Compiler/SDK witnesses are not a complete shared-library/header closure or reproducibility proof.

Mach-O parser bounds every command by sizeofcmds and its own structure, validates version/tool-table fields, refuses ambiguous or foreign platform declarations, LC_RPATH and malformed/non-system dependency names. Generic zero-command synthetic fixtures keep minimum:null; Mac producer requires 11.0.0. ELF implementation and original ELF tests remain unchanged.

ci_ordering.limits: Fixed fake normalization/git/Cargo/auditor/xcrun commands verify orchestration and inherited declared values only. No real SDK discovery, toolchain build or hosted runner qualification is implied.

local_validation.conditions: Normal-use 16 GiB M4/macOS 26.6.2 with existing pinned Rust 1.99.0 / Node 22.14.0, offline dependency cache, two build jobs and debug info/incremental disabled. Synthetic credentials and owned loopback fixtures; no paid providers/evaluators, model download or user-config edits. No real positive Mac collector/SDK execution locally.
local_validation.owner_scope: Finite wall/output owners recheck source/AUX/reference bytes. No universal descendant/crash/outer-cancellation or external-network-instrumentation guarantee.
local_validation.ordinary_runtime_artifact_scope: No new ordinary product build or source-to-binary provenance is claimed here. The code changes are contributor tooling; all product/platform/performance/final-artifact gates remain separate.

retained_corrections.lint_fix: Two allocation-free Path comparisons and integer is_multiple_of idiom. Also clarify a stale parser comment and change the unchanged cold-tree guard error label from GNU to Native. Original failed lint owner remains.
retained_corrections.shell_review: Before execution, separate assignment/export to propagate setup failure and preserve xcrun clang++ argv[0] alias. GNU workflow was not edited.

previous_actual_gnu_evidence.scope: Actual original GNU artifacts and green CI are from this preceding source. They do not supply actual hosted Mac execution or fresh CI for this patch.

remaining: Hosted Mac CI producer execution and original uploaded run/attempt/source/report/binary association.
musl and 32-bit producer profiles, broader declared target coverage and production release workflow integration.

Supported minimum environments/CPU/TLS, paired live task quality, representative hardware, licenses, lifecycle and five source-qualification/final-archive approval envelopes. Larger-Mac validation remains explicitly deferred.
